title: GM Backs Sodium Ion Batteries for U.S. Grid Storage
summary: General Motors is investing in sodium-ion battery technology as an alternative to lithium-ion for U.S. grid energy storage applications. Sodium-ion batteries offer potential cost advantages and use more abundant materials, making them attractive for large-scale stationary energy storage.
problem_solved: Addresses the need for more sustainable and cost-effective grid-scale energy storage solutions that reduce dependence on scarce lithium and cobalt resources.
why_valuable: Sodium-ion technology could enable cheaper, more abundant energy storage for the power grid, accelerating the transition to renewable energy and reducing carbon emissions.
